single-pole-source-at-switch.reviewerNotes: Re-recorded after two content changes. (1) Terminal labels are Brass A / Brass B rather than Screw 1 / Screw 2. (2) The single-pole switch device note was rewritten to scope its claim: either brass screw takes the line on a PLAIN MECHANICAL single-pole switch only, and the note now names dimmers, timers, smart switches and occupancy sensors as marked LINE/LOAD, plus the GFCI case where reversing line and load leaves downstream receptacles unprotected. Device notes are now inside the content fingerprint. Topology, reference solutions and expectations unchanged; truth tables re-verified across every switch state.
